result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A ranks its findings explicitly, starting with the lack of a clear way to book. It covers every generic line and both vague buttons with reasons, and uses placeholders for all figures without making up any facts. B has a strong diagnosis of the unlinked PDF and good rewrites, but it invents commitments ('menos de 24 horas', 'mismo día', 'presupuesto antes de empezar') and its table is not ranked; it even lists the barrier it calls the main one last. A loses a little for its English labels ('Major', 'Fix') and because it ties prices to phoning less directly. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B names every generic line and both vague buttons with a reason, and it ranks its findings explicitly. It also keeps all figures as placeholders. Its weaknesses are English labels ('Major', 'Fix', 'Rewrite') mixed into the Spanish and placing the missing price/turnaround information fifth. A is fully in Spanish and best at tying the hidden PDF prices to people phoning, but it invents promises ('menos de 24 horas', same-day return, quote-before-work policy) and its findings table is not ranked.
